item.title: CCTV Captured Noor Mukadam Trying to Escape
item.description: Noor Mukadam was murdered in Islamabad in July 2021. CCTV footage documented her attempts to escape and became key evidence against Zahir Jaffer. The case led to his conviction and a death sentence upheld by Pakistan’s Supreme Court.

item.title: Verity by Colleen Hoover Is a BookTok Obsession
item.description: Verity, Colleen Hoover’s psychological thriller and BookTok hit. A writing job draws Lowen Ashleigh into a family’s private world, where a hidden manuscript raises disturbing questions about the woman whose work she was hired to finish.

item.title: Ashley Bocanegra Was Lured Into a Deadly Ambush
item.description: After discovering her fiancé’s affair, Antonetta Stevens used his phone to lure Ashley Bocanegra to a Georgia apartment complex. Stevens and Janine Gonzalez attacked the 30-year-old mother, who later died in hospital. Recorded footage helped investigators piece together what happened.
